pairs.why: An adult anaphylaxis that stays hypotensive after two IM doses is the same story, and IM epinephrine 0.5 mg, an epinephrine infusion and autoinjector discharge teaching repeat.

Both are a bee or wasp sting anaphylaxis still hypotensive after two IM epinephrine doses and fluid, and both key an epinephrine infusion with glucagon ready for beta blocker related refractory shock.

Both are a man stung by a wasp with anaphylaxis who stays at BP 76/40 after two IM doses and 2 L of fluid, and both key epinephrine 0.5 mg IM, an epinephrine infusion and discharge with two autoinjectors and allergist venom referral.
